snippet.title: Farming Camp | Official Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow SOEDESCO®!
Discord: https://discord.gg/soedesco
Website: http://www.soedesco.com/
Newsletter: https://bit.ly/2wsfR4f
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Soedesco
Twitter: https://twitter.com/soedesco
Instagram: https://instagram.com/soedesco

Discover Farming Camp, a cozy game set in a summer camp where you can grow crops, care for adorable animals, and enjoy relaxing activities in a charming pixel art world. This experience blends the essence of relaxing farming games with a warm, wholesome setting—perfect for cozy game fans looking to unwind.
But Farming Camp offers more: it’s also a competition where some campers may resort to sabotage to win. With a light yet engaging narrative, charismatic characters, and unexpected twists, it delivers a unique take on cozy games by combining relaxation, storytelling, and rivalry into one memorable experience.

🌾 COMING SOON 2026

Developed by Innerfire Studios.
Published by Soedesco.

Available on PC and consoles.

Wishlist Links:
🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2985880/Farming_Camp/
🖥️ PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017993
🎯 Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/farming-camp/9NZGTX06V7MD
🕹️ Nintendo Switch (eShop): Coming Soon!

Add to your wishlist and start your farming journey!

Video editor:
@juanfranrivero

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
